overview: List of Papers (894.918, 1930-37) indexes expanding Japanese press bans, military/naval censorship, foreign correspondent and news-service controls, confiscated publications, and Manchuria-related restrictions, featuring reports from Forbes and Grew and the 1936 suppression of Current History.

subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers for File 894.918
subfiles.about: A four-page index of reports, telegrams, memoranda, and correspondence concerning Japanese press restrictions and censorship from 1930 through 1937.
subfiles.summary: Traces expanding Japanese press controls from political/military bans to troop movements, aviation, cartoons, and imported books; details the 1936 confiscation of Current History over Hodges's 'Japanese Enigma' article and suppression of the Japan Advertiser for advocating neutrality.

interest: Shows Japan's 1930s expansion of press censorship, linking domestic bans to foreign correspondents, publications, and Manchuria.
